displayName: A Wing – Community, Justice & Liberal Studies
description: This wing hosts Community, Justice, and Liberal Studies programs, including spaces for community services, law enforcement training, early childhood education, and liberal arts.
This wing contains automotive training bays and justice simulation labs used for hands-on technical and applied learning.
This wing includes key student services such as the Registrar's Office, Learning Support, IT Service Desk, Campus Store, and the Food Court.
This wing contains engineering technology labs and classrooms for civil, electrical, and mechanical engineering technology programs.

displayName: EA Wing – Joyce Centre for Partnership & Innovation
description: This wing is home to the Joyce Centre for Partnership and Innovation, supporting collaboration between students, faculty, and industry partners.
This wing houses creative industries studios and digital labs for students in media, arts, and design programs.
This wing is home to the Mohawk Students' Association, including student services, offices, and spaces for events and activities.
This wing contains the Cummings Library and Collaboratory, offering study zones, collaboration spaces, and digital learning resources.

displayName: I Wing – McKeil School of Business
description: This wing hosts classrooms for the McKeil School of Business, including programs in business, accounting, marketing, and entrepreneurship.
This wing includes health simulation labs, wellness program spaces, and supports for international students.
This wing contains conference and meeting rooms used for events, presentations, and group discussions.
This wing is home to Advancement and Alumni Engagement offices, supporting alumni relations and institutional development.

displayName: Q Wing – School of Engineering Technology
description: This wing houses the School of Engineering Technology, with specialized labs and classrooms for applied engineering programs.

displayName: R Wing – David Braley Athletic & Recreation Centre
description: This wing contains the David Braley Athletic and Recreation Centre, including fitness facilities, courts, and recreational spaces.
